{{Top|leg}}
An '''Ascian dagger''' was a bladed throwing weapon. [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Infiltrator (starfighter)|Infiltrator]] [[Harovan Toth]] was adept at using them.<ref name="Cracken">{{JournalCite|11|Cracken's Rebel Operatives (article)}}</ref> They were named after [[Ascian]], a [[Binary star/Legends|binary]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]], from were they supposedly originated.<ref name="Fly">''[[Fly Casual]]''</ref>
